title: Thailand and Cambodia, July 2025: a country note priced per fact
customer: A cross-border trade and travel-insurance desk (land crossings, factory supply runs through Poipet and Aranyaprathet, trip-cancellation claims) that must know which crossings were shut and whether fighting stopped before it pays claims or reroutes trucks.
note: Claims written the way a desk analyst would put them in a note. Observations are checked through Telegraph; forecasts are listed and not bought. c6 is the failure case on purpose: Thailand declared martial law in eight border districts, it did not declare war, and a note that says it did would trigger the wrong policy clause.
